newsitem.title: USA: Varlen CEO Wellek elected chairman.
newsitem.headline: Varlen CEO Wellek elected chairman.

text.p: Varlen Corp, a transportation products manufacturer, said Thursday its chief executive officer, Richard Wellek, was elected chairman of the board.
Ernest Lorch, who had been non-executive chairman since 1985, was elected senior chairman and will serve as the company's lead outside director, the company said.
Raymond Jean, chief operating officer, was promoted to the additional post as president, which Wellek had held, the company said.
"The board took these actions as part of its annual review of Varlen's long-term strategic plan, which includes succession planning," Lorch said in a news release.
